audience: consultants and coaches who take bookings through TidyCal

useCases.title: Review the bookings for the coming week
useCases.text: List the bookings that start after a set time. Open one booking to read its time, contact, meeting link and questions.

useCases.title: Check which booking types are open for clients
useCases.text: List the booking types and their disabled state. Then list the open times a client can still book for one type.

useCases.title: Turn a booking type off and back on
useCases.text: Disable a booking type so clients cannot book it. Existing bookings stay. Enable it again when you are ready to take bookings.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking without emailing the client
useCases.text: Read one booking, then cancel it with notify set to false, so TidyCal sends no email. A cancellation cannot be undone through the API.

useCases.title: Keep client records up to date
useCases.text: Create a contact with a name and email. Later, update the timezone or phone number of that contact.
